description: Deploy a static site to a preview from its files or a ZIP or tar archive. Use when the user has a static site (an index.html) and no connected repository. Before: a key (test or live) and the site files with index.html at the root. Returns the deploy (djy_...), its preview address and preview_access_token when wait.outcome is ready; otherwise call advance_deploy until ready or failed. Test or live keys: the preview is made in the key's project. Scope: deploy:create. Cost: free (previews are not charged). Works with a test or a live connection; production is a promotion approved by a person.

archive_base64.description: A ZIP or tar archive of the site, base64-encoded, with index.html at its root. For files that are not text.

expires_at.description: ISO 8601 end of the preview, at most 7 days ahead. Omit for 00:00 UTC in 4 days.

files.description: The site's text files by relative path (index.html at the root is required). Give files or archive_base64, not both.

idempotency_key.description: Unique per deploy (16-128 chars). Reuse it on retry.

name: deploy_archive
title: Deploy files or an archive
